name: python-bellman-ford
title: Bellman Weight Walker
blurb: Single-source shortest paths over small integer-weighted digraphs: the walker's distance map equals the shipped walk-counting oracle's map on every shipped and seeded corpus, no edge still relaxes after |V|-1 rounds, and negative cycles are named honestly.
default_description: A weight walker whose distance map is the oracle's map on every small digraph, and whose settled check refuses a surviving relaxation.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: no cheaper walk survives a settled edge
